permissions.title: Permission check (advanced)
permissions.description:
Works out the smallest set of Pangolin permissions the ticked features need, compares it with what this integration's key (ID `{key_id}`) has, and can add what is missing or remove what is not needed. Tick features that are off today to add the permissions they need.

**Requirements:** Pangolin has two kinds of API keys. **Organization keys** are made in an organization's Settings > API Keys, and even with every box ticked they can't read or change key permissions (those permissions aren't offered for them). **Root keys** are made by a server admin in Server Admin > API Keys. To compare and change permissions, enter a root key that has **List API Key Actions** and **Set API Key Allowed Actions**. It is used only for this check and is never saved. If this integration itself runs on a root key, that key also needs **Create API Key**. Without a root key you just get the list of permissions to set yourself.

**Warning: use at your own risk.** Changing API key permissions can cut off features you use now, features added in later versions of this integration, and anything else that uses the same key. If that happens, fix the key in the Pangolin dashboard or run this check again. This is an unofficial integration and its authors are not responsible for lost access, connection problems or other issues caused by permission changes.
